question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is "Dutyful."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is 'Dutyful.'
 
• The correct spelling is "Dutiful."
 
• "Dutiful" means happy to respect and obey somebody. (कर्तव्यपरायण, कर्तव्यशील)
 
 
• Example: *He is a **dutiful**__ son.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Thankful: **pleased and grateful. (प्रसन्‍न और चिंतामुक्त)
 
• **Merciful: **feeling or showing mercy. (दयावान, सहृदय)
 
• **Plentiful: **available in large amounts or numbers. (बड़ी मात्रा में राशि में उपलब्‍ध)
